findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: The facility could not produce any food manager certificates. The only Certified Food Manager on file wasn’t available during the visit. PIC mentioned that the certificates were locked in the office room and the employees did not have a key to access the documents at the time of the inspection. Ensure that there is always a certified food protection manager present during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: The employee who normally handles food was observed processing transactions at the register and engaging in food prep without washing hands. Discussed with PIC the need to wash hands before handling food since there was an interruption of tasks. Ensure that employees wash hands in between changing tasks to avoid cross contaminating food.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: The PIC mentioned that employees normally wash hands in the ware-washing sink where dishes are cleaned. Discussed with PIC that handwashing should only occur in the handwashing sink. The triple sink shall only be used for cleaning dishes. Ensure that hands are washed in the designated hand sink only.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.15 Where to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands in a HANDWASHING SINK or APPROVED automatic handwashing facility and may not clean their hands in a sink used for FOOD preparation or WAREWASHING, or in a service sink or a curbed cleaning facility used for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source.
findings.comment: The facility is serving yogurt dipped grapes. When asked the source of the grapes, the PIC wasn’t aware of where the grapes are being made. Discussed that food sold for public consumption must be made in an approved permitted kitchen. The facility was instructed to not serve the grapes to the public. Will follow-up on November 24, 2025 to gather more information about the food source.
findings.citation_text: 3-201.11(A) Compliance with Food Law. (A) FOOD shall be obtained from sources that comply with LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There are several missing ceiling tiles in the back storage area where single service items, bottled drinks, and the ice machine are stored. PIC was able to replace one ceiling tile, however, the facility is still expected to replace the remaining missing tiles. Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
The top inside surface of the ice machine was observed to be heavily soiled with mold. PIC stated that the machine will be serviced and cleaned as soon as possible. Ensure that food-contact surfaces of the ice machine are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent accumulation and possible contamination of food. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed the baffles of the ice machine to have mold accumulation. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that baffles are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent mold accumulation and possible contamination. Will follow-up on 12/2/2024. 

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: There wasn't a sanitizer solution present at the start of the inspection. Discussed with PIC and sanitizer solution was created and tested at 200ppm. Be sure sanitizer solutions are available during food preparation to ensure that food contact surfaces are properly getting sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. 
(B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
The individual who was handling food during the inspection isn’t food handler certified. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that employees who are not Food Manager certified are food handler certified if handling or preparing food.

410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: There was no CFM present during the inspection. Ensure there are enough CFM's present to cover all hours of food prep and operation. 
(A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed the employee making subs to wash his hands and operate the faucet without using a barrier. Ensure a barrier is used to operate the faucet after washing hands. Education provided during the inspection. 
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed the ice machine to be soiled with mold and mildew. The ice machine and other equipment food contact surfaces must be clean to sight and touch. 
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
There were no sani buckets present and being used during the inspection. Sani buckets with sanitizer must be used and available when food preparation occurs. A sani bucket was made during the inspection. 
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the mop head to be stored inside the mop bucket, which did not allow it to air dry properly. Mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry.
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the floor under the walk in cooler fast to be soiled. Ensure the floor is cleaned as often as necessary to keep clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: There was no CFM present during the inspection. Ensure there are enough CFM's present to cover all hours of food prep and operation. 
(A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: Observed no employee reporting agreements to be signed by the employees. Also, there was no employee health policy in place during the inspection. These must be signed by all employees. The reporting agreements were signed by the employees during the inspection. 

(A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: There were no sani buckets present and being used during the inspection. Sani buckets with sanitizer must be used and available when food preparation occurs. A sani bucket was made during the inspection. 
(A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed
findings.comment:
5-403.11: Observed the wastewater in the mop bucket to be sitting in the mop bucket. The water was used earlier in the day and had not been disposed. Ensure the wastewater is disposed of after use. The water was dumped during the inspection. 
SEWAGE shall be disposed through an APPROVED facility that is: (A) A public SEWAGE treatment plant (B) An individual SEWAGE disposal system that is sized, constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-403.11: Observed employee milk and drinks to be on the same shelf as food being sold in the walk in cooler. Ensure employees have a designated area for drinks and other food. The milk was moved during the inspection. 
(A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use tobacco shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES cannot occur.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text: 2-301.15  (Pf) Food employee washed hands at the three-compartment sink. Food employee must wash hands at the hand washing sink. Reference 2-301.15.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Observed the ice machine in the back of the store to be soiled. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A).

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) and (B)  (P) Observed turkey, ham, roast beef, and tomatos to be at temperatures between 47 and 49 F. time/temperature control for safety foods must maintain a temperature of 41 F or below. PIC stated that the food had been in the prep cooler since the night before. The food items were discarded during the inspection. Reference 3-501.16(A)(2) and (B).

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment: 4-204-112  (C) A thermometer is not provided in the prep cooler and the walk in cooler. Cold/Hot holding equipment used for Time/Temperature Control for Safety food shall have at least one thermometer in an easily viewed location. Reference 4-204-112.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14  (C) In-use wiping cloths are not stored properly. Cloths used for wiping spills shall be maintained dry. Cloths used to wipe surfaces and equipment shall be held in proper sanitizer solution. Cloths in-use for wiping surfaces in contact with raw animalfoods shall be kept separate from cloths used for other purposes. In-use cloths must be laundered daily. Reference 3-304.14.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.16  (C) Observed the mop head to be stored resting on the ground. Mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.  Reference 6-501.16.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11  (C) Observed missing and broken ceiling tiles to be broken or missing througout the premesis. Except as specified in Section 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are smooth and easily cleanable.  Reference 6-201.11.

Turkey deli meat in reach in deli cooler at 52F for an unknown amount of time.

750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)
